verdict.rationale: Claude Code's entire interaction model is built on natural-language instructions: docs describe typing plain-language requests ('Describe what you want in plain language...'), example prompts like JIRA/Figma/PostgreSQL tasks, and CLI usage (`claude`) that accepts free-text commands, corroborated by community usage descriptions of prompting it for multi-file/multi-language tasks. Missing for 10: an independent hands-on demonstration specifically isolating natural-language command parsing (vs. general task-quality feedback).
